scope: Local disposable PostgreSQL, production services/control/lifecycle and actual in-process Worker routes/SDK with injected authentication, scheduler and storage boundaries. No deployed requests, providers, billing consumption or live history changes.
problem: A new render key absorbed by another active Project run had no durable key alias. After that run completed, replay of the absorbed key could reset completed ordinary render cache rows, admit another run and record another charged start.
implementation: Reuse existing actor/workspace-scoped OperationReceipt with render_clips command and receipt-derived native run key; no new table, migration, generic receipt model or compatibility path
Fingerprint canonical caller selector, normalized requested ratios and requested resolution; omitted clipIds remains all-clips selector rather than a fresh derived clip list
Authorize every invocation; replay resolves before any mutable membership or entitlement derivation

Original transaction records exact selected IDs and public response with pending work, unfrozen run membership and initial dispatch; internal selection records identity only, never execution authority
Keep public response shape unchanged; frozen work sets retain normal drain behavior
Recover only the exact scoped current-epoch live run from receipt or native CampaignOperation result, without new admission or changed deadline/charge history
CampaignOperation result replay recollects its exact dispatch; caller loss before result persistence resumes the underlying immutable receipt

callerInventory.withoutClipIds: Direct ClipService.triggerClipRendering call; previously no OperationReceipt or CampaignOperation wrapper
callerInventory.withClipIds: CampaignOperationService.renderSelected native receipt; existing completed result guards ordinary successful replay, but prior crash window depended on lost native alias
callerInventory.mcpRestBackground: No production caller of triggerClipRendering/admitClipRendering in MCP, public REST integration commands or background modules; integrations generation uses its separate existing generation receipt path
callerInventory.unusedHelper: ClipService.queueFollowUpRenderRun has no production caller; normal drain admission stays in workflow lifecycle

cases: one charged start through actual service/lifecycle and unwrapped HTTP after terminal replay
late clip creation preserves original all-clips result/selection
concurrent distinct aliases share one run
closed accepted replay with fresh admission refusal
caller loss before CampaignOperation result persistence
all-clips and selected HTTP registration failure and confirmation wait

remaining: Root review, full release checks/build/import audit and paired deployed qualification remain required; local fixtures are not platform success. No deadline or historical task reset.

reviewCorrection.deferredSelection: Record which exact accepted pending IDs were deferred by the frozen parent in the existing internal receipt; those facts are identity data, not execution authority.
reviewCorrection.exactDrainRecovery: Read fresh scoped current-epoch parent and only its one exact drain successor. Register deferred accepted work before positive response while drain is queued/unfrozen; after freeze require exact current membership with no terminal historical outcome. Never redirect through mutable cache IDs to unrelated/later work or walk a run graph.
reviewCorrection.campaignRecovery: Completed CampaignOperation repair reads its original actor's exact matching render_clips receipt, without executing as that actor. Pending continuation by another currently authorized actor returns existing typed campaign_operation_forbidden before claim/execute. Completed workspace-visible replay policy remains.
negativeCases: both all-clips and selected actual HTTP fail delayed drain registration then block identical replay until confirmation before drain freeze

two authorized members: pending cross-actor service and HTTP refusal after original receipt/caller loss/terminal render, no other-actor receipt or claim mutation, one charged start, original actor recovery, completed workspace replay retained
ordinary IDs reused by later accepted work do not redirect old receipts; completed late member reset while exact drain remains live is also a no-op
same original selector/fingerprint, response, receipt rollback, frozen membership, run deadlines, attempts and charges retained
